title: Numbers 19:1-3 — the statute of the unblemished red heifer
summary: Numbers 19:1-3 in English with selected letters and words in colour (LORD, Moses, Israel, Eleazar, unblemished, red heifer, no defect, a yoke has never been placed, it). The LORD tells Moses and Aaron to have Israel bring an unblemished red heifer with no defect and never yoked, to be given to Eleazar the priest and slaughtered outside the camp in his presence.

text.text: The Ordinance of the Red Heifer
1 Then the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

2 “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded, saying, ‘Speak to the sons of Israel that they bring you an unblemished red heifer in which is no defect and on which a yoke has never been placed.
3 ‘You shall give it to Eleazar the priest, and it shall be brought outside the camp and be slaughtered in his presence.
